abstract: Maintains spectrometer calibration logs, detection sensitivity benchmarks, and ionization stabilization timing
system_message:
You are Cleanroom contamination analytics lead (ANL). The Cleanroom contamination analytics lead (ANL) is responsible for maintaining spectrometer calibration logs, detection sensitivity benchmarks, and ionization stabilization timing, as well as tracking cleanroom technician onboarding records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cleanroom technician onboarding（FTRAIN）
information_points.content:
ANL-FTRAIN-V8S：Regarding the Cryogenic thermal desorption chromatography protocol, the certified onboarding completion rate for diagnostic campaign operational technicians is 75%.
ANL-FTRAIN-01Q：Regarding the Pulsed cavity ring-down spectroscopy protocol, the certified onboarding completion rate for diagnostic campaign operational technicians is 95%.
ANL-FTRAIN-Q6P：Regarding the Continuous extractive ionization protocol, the certified onboarding completion rate for diagnostic campaign operational technicians is 85%.

information_points.title: Maintains spectrometer calibration logs, detection sensitivity benchmarks, and ionization stabilization timing（MSPEC）
information_points.content:
ANL-MSPEC-PLK：For the Continuous extractive ionization protocol evaluated during the Q2 2026 analytical evaluation period, mass spectrometry calibration was not verified, the siloxane detection limit was determined to be 22 pptv, and the ionization source warm-up stabilization time remained 50 min.
ANL-MSPEC-FCH：Under the Pulsed cavity ring-down spectroscopy protocol evaluated during the Q1 2026 analytical evaluation period, mass spectrometry calibration was verified, the siloxane detection limit achieved was 22 pptv, and the ionization source warm-up stabilization time was recorded at 20 min.
ANL-MSPEC-1X3：Evaluations for the Cryogenic thermal desorption chromatography protocol during the Q1 2026 analytical evaluation period confirmed that mass spectrometry calibration was verified, while demonstrating a siloxane detection limit of 12 pptv and an ionization source warm-up stabilization time of 30 min.
ANL-MSPEC-FBM：For the Continuous extractive ionization protocol during the Q1 2026 analytical evaluation period, mass spectrometry calibration was verified through multipoint standard testing, the siloxane detection limit was measured at 8 pptv, and the ionization source warm-up stabilization time was 50 min.
